name: Runtime - Gateway Outage Sentinel (G8 Restart Guard)
contract_reason: Owner-directed 2026-09-18 ('Let's build the restart guard'). Every recorded gateway outage (2026-09-09, 2026-09-15) was a Windows Update reboot in the 00:00-06:00 Phoenix window that cost the morning refresh and voided an observation session. The sentinel writes a durable 15-minute heartbeat; on recovery it detects the missed gap, corroborates with Windows System reboot events (readable unelevated, proven 2026-09-16), and classifies the gap against the G8 voiding windows (06:00-13:00 Phoenix on 2026-09-18/21/22/23; closed-market observation 09-20). Exit 1 + owner Telegram alert on a voiding-class gap so the five-session count restart is announced immediately on recovery rather than discovered hours later. Detection only: it cannot prevent a reboot, repair the gateway, or mutate anything.
description: G8 restart guard: writes a durable heartbeat timestamp every 15 minutes; on recovery after an outage, classifies the missed gap against the G8 declared observation windows (06:00-13:00 Phoenix on 2026-09-18/21/22/23, closed-market 09-20) and corroborates with Windows System reboot events. Exit 1 + owner alert on a voiding-class gap. Routine runs are silent.
stop_lines: Detection and alerting only; no repair or restart of the gateway by automation.
No config, auth, network, channel, service, plugin, or runtime mutation.
No finance, canon, portfolio, account, order, or execution authority.
No owner-approval inference; a voiding-class detection is evidence for the owner, not a session-voiding action by the system.
